newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Four injured as airliner skids off Taiwan runway.
newsitem.headline: Four injured as airliner skids off Taiwan runway.

text.p: A Garuda Indonesia Boeing 747 passenger jet skidded off the runway when it touched down at Taiwan's international airport early on Thursday, airport officials said.
"Four passengers on board were injured, and one of them was hospitalised because of bone fracture. The rest of the passengers were fine," an airline official told Reuters by telephone.
She said the plane was carrying 281 passengers from the Indonesian resort island of Bali. The cause of the accident was not immediately known, she said.
Airport officials said preliminary investigations showed that the accident could have been caused by a tyre blast.
